I love making things. Whether its physical object, drawings, stories, etc. I enjoy all of it.

What I don't enjoy(usually) is the finished product.
I'll get all excited about using some cool Idea I came up with in a drawing, and when I'm done, it looks like crap to me. Because of this, only about 10% of the things I make/do are ever shown to anyone else. only about 15% of it even still exists. not really even sure why I'm posting this (I almost deleted this post right here), but I guess I feel like I needed to 'tell' someone.

Heh, I think I'm in the same boat. Things are simply hardly ever good enough for me to be happy :p I'm pretty sure I'll never finish writing my book because of this. I rewrote everything several times and now I'm too lazy or hardly have any time left to pick it up again. Oh well :)

You're not alone!

For me, it has always been like that and it makes it harder to do many things at the time but it also means that you can dive deeper into a concept or product than other people might ever be willing or able to. So there is definitely a positive side to it too :)

But yes, sometimes it can really get on your nerves. For me, it goes to the lengths of rereading a text message to friends a couple of times before being happy with it (I reread this comment at least 3 times ;))

You see all the flaws bc it's your work. Others don't see the flaws, they see the uniqueness, the creativity, the passion. Take paintings for example, they are prized for their uniqueness, not their perfection. Most things in life with a high value are valuable because of their rarity, not their lack of flaws. In fact, I would go so far as to say, imperfections add value to one of a kind items.

You will always feel this way but try to realize that it is a bias not reality.

User /u/PuttItOut has developed a new feature which parses all image links in comments and converts them into a sort of image loaders. The link will look the way it always did except now it will get a suffix that looks like this: (img). If you click on this link, the image should show up.

Are we there yet?

This feature is not fully developed yet, but it is already live and usable. Please leave comments and questions here and me and /u/PuttItOut will try to answer them.

Plans for the future

Similar feature will be developed for other type of media (videos perhaps) and writing text like /u/something will also convert the text to a link to users profile page. The same goes for writing /v/somenamehere.

Edit: this feature will also work in message type submissions

Edit 2: /u/PuttItOut developed this feature further to support youtube, and vimeo links. Imgur album support is under development as well.

Edit 3: I developed video preview for YouTube and Vimeo as well, so you can now watch link type submissions without having to open the comments section.
